name: bubblegum-atelier
description: Full-stack AI boutique — FastAPI + React, ML models retrained in CI on every push. Docker, 34 tests, live on Render + Netlify.

paragraphs: An AI-assisted boutique storefront — full-stack, containerized, and live on the internet.
⏳ The API runs on a free tier that naps when idle. A keep-alive workflow in this repo pings it every few minutes so the first visitor never meets a cold start.
features: 87 products across 7 categories — shoes, bags, dresses, tops, bottoms, accessories, makeup (₹349–₹2,999)
Cohesive AI-generated lookbook photography — one studio look across the whole catalogue
Live search (name + category aware) and one-tap category chips
Zoom modal — open any product, zoom and pan to inspect the detail, pick a size
Wishlist (hearts) and shopping bag with quantity controls

whatItDoes.text: An AI-assisted boutique storefront — full-stack, containerized, and live on the internet.

requirements.text: Name + secret-word sign-in (/identity/register, /identity/login) with returning-customer handling
All data endpoints require the header X-API-Key.
